info.name: Oracle EBS Human Resources API
info.description:
RESTful APIs for Oracle E-Business Suite Human Resources Management System (HRMS) including employee management, payroll processing, workforce administration, compensation, and benefits. These PL/SQL APIs are deployed as REST services through the Integrated SOA Gateway.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
 Email: support@oracle.com
